title.zh-CN: 欢迎来到长安：三教相遇的城市
title.en: Welcome to Chang'an: a city of encounters

description.zh-CN: 展览入口音频脚本，说明现实地图、传统层与研究层如何并置。
description.en: An entrance script explaining how real geography, traditional layers and research layers are placed together.

transcript.zh-CN: 欢迎来到长安。这里不寻找一个把道、儒、佛融成一体的答案，而是观察它们如何在城市、制度、文本和人的移动中相遇。
transcript.en: Welcome to Chang'an. We are not looking for an answer that fuses Dao, Ru and Fo into one. We are observing how they met through cities, institutions, texts and movement.

description.zh-CN: 《心经》段落的朗读脚本；正式录音前需完成版本、断句和语音审校。
description.en: A reading script for a Heart Sutra passage; version, punctuation and pronunciation review precede recording.

transcript.zh-CN: 本段朗读以明确版本为起点。请先看原文与定位，再听解释；声音不会替代文本证据。
transcript.en: This reading begins from an explicit version. See the wording and locator before listening to the interpretation; sound does not replace textual evidence.

description.zh-CN: 研究层导览脚本，解释历史记录、传统叙事、象征层和学术解释的区别。
description.en: A research-layer guide distinguishing historical records, traditional narratives, symbolic layers and scholarly interpretation.

transcript.zh-CN: 当页面写着历史记录、传统叙事或象征层时，它们不是同一个证据等级。请打开来源面板，查看每个判断从哪里来、还缺什么。
transcript.en: Historical record, traditional narrative and symbolic layer are not the same evidence grade. Open the source panel to see where each claim comes from and what is still missing.
